description: Professional tellers are responsible for providing a positive customer experience that leads to improved satisfaction and sales.

Process transactions accurately and efficiently in a fast-paced environment while simultaneously introducing products and services that meet the customer's needs and encouraging customers to expand their relationship with Bank of America.
Ensure customers/clients are quickly connected to the appropriate teammate with the expertise to meet their needs.

Interacting among clients with a primary focus on business retention and new business roll outs; provided superior support services aligned to the client's priorities in order to drive loyalty and maximize the business value of their investment.

Driven to meet all sales goals and educated all customers on available promotions and product plans. Maintain strong knowledge of all products, accessories, pricing plans, promotions and service features.

Review, plan, and implement aircraft and crew schedules from day of scheduled events to 6 months in advance to ensure optimum crew and aircraft usage relative to clients requests while accounting for crew rest requirements, crew schedules, aircraft maintenance, and unexpected developments.

Provided high-level administrative support to 5 leading military officials by conducting research, preparing statistical reports, handling information requests, and performing clerical functions such as preparing correspondence, emailing, receiving visitors, arranging conference calls, and scheduling meetings.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate has a diverse professional background with experience in banking, retail sales, aviation resource management, and administration. Their skills include customer service, interpersonal communication, problem-solving, and multi-tasking, which are crucial for roles that require interacting directly with clients and providing excellent support services.
